title: Environment-bound Local Connector routing and recovery isolation

phases.objective: Make Local Connector routing environment-bound and fail closed so tenant/device traffic cannot silently escalate to admin recovery and connector callbacks cannot return to the wrong environment control plane.

e2e_journeys.actor: Tenant or API-credential caller through the environment control plane
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A /connector/:device_id proxy request resolved against the receiving environment database
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Candidate routes remain tenant/device routes only; admin_recovery is excluded unless an admin principal supplies an explicit recovery intent.
steps: Resolve tenant, user, canonical device, and config from the receiving runtime database.
Load enabled route candidates for the resolved config.
Exclude admin_recovery routes for non-admin callers and for admin callers without explicit recovery intent.
Forward only the selected device route and strip the control-plane recovery selector from the device request.
assertions: tenant and API-credential callers cannot receive admin_recovery as a fallback candidate
admin authority alone does not enable recovery fallback without explicit recovery intent
recovery_intent is not forwarded to the local device
connector.mad4b.com remains an admin recovery role rather than a tenant runtime route

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Connector installer emitted by Production or Staging control plane
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The generated connector environment binds policy and heartbeat callbacks to the same environment control plane and fails closed on a cross-environment override.
steps: Select only auth.mad4b.com for Production or dev.mad4b.com for Staging.
Persist CONNECTOR_ENVIRONMENT and CONNECTOR_CONTROL_PLANE_BASE_URL into the connector environment.
Derive policy and heartbeat URLs from that validated base URL.
Reject a configured control-plane URL whose hostname does not match the resolved environment.
assertions: Staging connector callbacks cannot default to auth.mad4b.com
Production connector callbacks cannot target dev.mad4b.com
connector-dev.mad4b.com is declared planned and excluded from both application hostname families
no provider, DNS, live database, or Production deployment mutation is performed by this change
